literal: I have forgotten the way (m) — ગઈ છું for a woman
is there a way without stairs?
I cannot climb stairs (m) — શકતી for a woman
will help be got at the station?
to me very little is seen
will a coin or token be needed?
is the tap water fit to drink?
may the bathroom key be got?
where is the place for washing hands?
is it fine to flush the paper?
is there a toilet in this?
